name: Kil'hala
summary: Kil'hala is a jungle troll tailoring trainer stationed at the Crossroads in the Barrens. Skilled in working with both everyday cloth and exotic woven materials, he instructs Horde crafters looking to refine their needlework. Beyond common thread, he weaves nether-lace robes for young Horde mages who bring him locks of hair from the laughing sisters of Ashenvale.

sections.title: Tailor of the Barrens
sections.body: Positioned at the bustling hub of the Crossroads, Kil'hala offers his tailoring expertise to passing travelers and Horde recruits. While much of his craft involves common spun bolts and garments fit for dry plains life, his knowledge extends into rare magical textiles. As a favor to the mage Deino, he fashions nether-lace robes for young mages who bring him hair taken from the laughing sisters, dryads of Ashenvale's forests.

faq.answer: Kil'hala is a Darkspear troll and a tailoring trainer located at the Crossroads in the Barrens. He assists Horde tradesfolk in learning the basics of weaving cloth and garment construction.
He is located in the Barrens within the central settlement of the Crossroads, situated alongside other Horde trade trainers.

faq.q: What tasks does Kil'hala give to tailors?
faq.answer: He doesn't send tailors out himself. Young Horde mages sent by Deino bring him locks of hair from the Laughing Sisters, dryads near Ashenvale's Raynewood Retreat, and Kil'hala weaves the hair into a nether-lace garment for them.

angles.text: Kil'hala is an essential stop for journeyman Horde tailors traversing Kalimdor, teaching craft techniques and offering quests to weave exotic magical robes.
Providing textile goods and tradecraft training in the Crossroads, Kil'hala helps equip the warband and travelers carving a foothold in the Barrens.
